operations_plan.summary: Apply a 0.2 mm equal-distance chamfer to both circular opening edges of all six through holes: the four base mounting holes and the two coaxial clevis-lug pin bores. The hole scope, treatment of both ends, and 45-degree/equal-distance definition resolve ambiguities using the nominal interpretation in aim.json; explicit edge IDs are unavailable, so the target edges must be retrieved topologically from the identified cylindrical bore faces.

steps.description: Inspect solid 0 and confirm that the six referenced cylindrical faces are actual through-hole bore walls rather than external boss or lug-crown surfaces. Establish the chamfer scope as the two circular boundary edges of each bore face, producing 12 target rim edges in total. Do not select circular edges belonging to the rounded outer boss walls, annular-pad perimeters, lug crowns, shell blends, or recessed mounting-pad boundaries.

Retrieve the mounting-hole rim edges for feature F-01 by querying the two circular boundary loops of each cylindrical bore face 49, 50, 51, and 52. For every bore, select the boundary edge adjacent to its annular seating region and the opposite boundary edge at the other end of the through hole. Use adjacency to annular seating faces 86, 84, 87, and 88 and to the opposite mounting-side opening, including main bottom mounting plane 77 where applicable, to validate the selections. Preserve the bore axes, centers, spacing, through extents, and the unchanged cylindrical diameter away from the local edge treatment.

Retrieve the clevis pin-bore rim edges for features F-02 and F-03 by querying both circular boundary edges of cylindrical bore faces 44 and 46. Validate the left-lug edges by their adjacency to outer and inner lug side faces 78 and 90, and validate the right-lug edges by adjacency to outer and inner lug side faces 79 and 89. Confirm that all four selected edges belong to the coaxial transverse pin passage and that no edges from rounded lug crowns 74 and 68 or lug-support blends are included.

Create one edge-chamfer feature on the 12 circular rim edges collected in steps OP-01-S02 and OP-01-S03. Set the chamfer size to 0.2 mm and use an equal-distance chamfer, equivalent to a nominal 45-degree bevel. Apply the feature simultaneously where supported; otherwise apply equivalent 0.2 mm chamfer features to the mounting-hole and clevis-bore edge groups while maintaining identical parameters. The operation must remove only a narrow annular wedge at each opening and must not alter the remaining bore walls or surrounding functional geometry.

Regenerate and validate solid 0. Confirm that each of the six through holes has a 0.2 mm annular chamfer at both ends, for 12 new chamfer faces total, and that no sharp target rim remains. Verify that the cylindrical bore portions beyond the chamfers retain their original diameters, axes, center locations, coaxiality, and through extents. Also verify that mounting-pad profiles, boss outer walls, clevis-lug thickness and spacing, shell surfaces, ribs, blends, underside cavity, and overall bracket dimensions remain unchanged, and confirm that the result remains one valid watertight solid.
